dataset: Iowa DNR 2024 Title V point-source Appendix A

source.author: Nick Page
source.metadata_conflict: Search metadata says 2021; the actual PDF cover says 2024 and February 25, 2026. Use the archived PDF's period.

record_grain: One DNR Appendix A facility inventory ID, not one parent company, person, stack, chemical or census tract

identifier.system: DNR point-source inventory facility ID as printed
identifier.crosswalk_rule: Verify location, identifiers, program-specific IDs and dated aliases. Do not join by a similar facility name alone. No county mapping is inferred from ID digits.

time.not_current_year: This is not a 2026 emissions inventory. Facility names are retained as printed for the 2024 inventory.

units.csv_wording: tons/year (report wording; ton definition not specified in PDF)
units.conversion_status: The PDF does not explicitly define a short ton vs metric tonne. No pounds or metric conversion is applied in the CSV. Confirm the source system definition before conversion or comparison with TRI pounds.

fields.facility_id: DNR inventory ID, kept as text
fields.facility_name: Name as printed, joining wrapped continuation lines with one space
fields.pdf_page: One-based physical PDF page containing the facility row
fields.pm25_primary_tons: Primary particulate matter <=2.5 microns, report column PM25-PRI
fields.pm10_primary_tons: Primary particulate matter <=10 microns, report column PM10-PRI
fields.total_haps_tons: Total hazardous air pollutants, not total carcinogens

coverage.included: All 283 reported Title V facilities in Appendix A, physical PDF pages 20-30
coverage.extraction_exclusions: None; no row deduplication or threshold exclusions
coverage.coverage_limit: Title V is a regulatory inventory subset; it is not every Iowa employer or emissions source.

reproduction.method: Layout text extraction; identify facility ID + nine two-decimal numeric fields; append long facility-name continuation lines; retain reported numeric strings.
reproduction.precision: Two decimals as printed; summed rounded detail can differ from unpublished underlying values.

interpretation.overlap: PM2.5 is contained in PM10. HAPs may also occur in VOC or particulate totals. Do not sum all pollutant columns as independent mass or health burden.
interpretation.not_tri: DNR Title V point-source estimates and EPA TRI releases have different facility coverage, chemicals, media, thresholds and units. Do not add or equate their totals.
interpretation.not_dose: Emitted mass is not ambient concentration, personal dose, modeled cancer risk or observed cancer count.
interpretation.not_risk_rank: HAP mass includes agents with different potencies and noncancer hazards. Speciation, transport, exposure duration and dose-response are necessary for cancer assessment.
interpretation.change_over_time: Inventory differences can reflect revised factors, testing, reporting corrections, coverage or operation changes.
